description: Parse an SRT or WebVTT file and report the words-per-minute reading speed implied by each cue's word count and duration, flagging cues that exceed common broadcast accessibility guidelines (default: ~180 WPM, ~20 characters/second). HTML-style cue tags like <i> are stripped before counting words and characters.

cpsThreshold.description: Characters-per-second above which a cue is flagged (default 20)

input.description: The SRT or WebVTT file contents

wpmThreshold.description: Words-per-minute above which a cue is flagged (default 180)

name: analyze_caption_speed
